summary: A stopgap is declared debt, never the solution (engineering 1.2.0, a-stopgap-is-declared-debt): a line that marks itself a stopgap with a comment tag -- HACK:, WORKAROUND:, STOPGAP:, TEMPORARY:, FIXME:, XXX: (or the tag followed by a parenthesis) -- names, on the same line, the tracking record that removes it. Each gate judges only the text an edit introduces and carries its own calibration. The tags are the widely used comment-tag convention, upper case and followed by ':' or '(', so prose ('a temporary table') and code ('CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE') are not stopgaps.

gates.because: a stopgap that names no tracked debt becomes the design: nobody owns its removal, and the next reader takes it for the solution (engineering: a-stopgap-is-declared-debt).
gates.instead: make the real fix; or, where it is out of reach now, mark the line with the tracking record whose exit condition removes it -- an issue key (ABC-123), #123, or card: <id> -- and have the owner approve the stopgap there.
